Subject: SIG onboarding request + SOC 2 / HIPAA scope follow-up

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and can kick off the questionnaire: 

- Redwood contact: Soojin Lee (Security intake / Solution lead) and Rachel Kim (CS lead).
- ClearStream contact: Alex Carter + security@clearstream-health.com.
- Primary ask: ClearStream wants vendor security evidence for procurement — preference for a SIG/CAIQ or your proprietary questionnaire.
- Security posture notes from call: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is underway (expected Q4 2026), you host in AWS (us-east-1) and encrypt data at rest; you also asked about Redwood BAA options for PHI/HIPAA.

Clarifying asks so we can route correctly to our Security team and prefill the SIG: 
1) Do you prefer a SIG Lite (short) or full SIG (v2) / CAIQ? If you send your questionnaire PDF we can map answers.
2) SOC 2 status: can you share whether you have a SOC 2 Type I report today or only in-progress Type II? If Type I exists, date of report and auditor name.
3) Data classification & residency: will you be sending PHI to Redwood? If yes, what's the expected volume and retention horizon?
4) Compliance needs: is a Redwood BAA required for your evaluation or is an attestation sufficient at procurement stage?
5) Evidence access: do you need on-demand artifact access (SOC reports, penetration test summaries) or redacted copies via secure link?

Next steps I propose: we can prefill the SIG using our standard map and return a prefilled spreadsheet for your security team to review. If you prefer we can also take your vendor questionnaire and produce a mapping. I’ll attach a SIG prefill template and a short mutual action plan (MAP).

Suggested meeting to finalize scope: Tue 2026-09-01 10:00 AM ET (30 min) — does that work?

Attachments: ClearStream_SIG_initial.xlsx (SIG prefill template), Redwood_SIG_map_v1.pdf (map stub).

Thanks — happy to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — great call. A few answers below and I attached our vendor questionnaire for reference.

1) Questionnaire preference: we typically run SIG Lite up front for speed, then request a full SIG or CAIQ for vendors moving to production. SIG Lite would be fine for procurement right now.
2) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type I from 2025 (BrightAudit LLC). Type II is in progress and expected to complete by 2026-11-15 (estimate).
3) Data & PHI: we will send limited PHI for a pilot (patient identifiers + anonymized notes). Expected monthly volume during pilot ~50k rows; retention for pilot data = 90 days, production retention TBD.
4) BAA: yes, we will require a signed BAA before any PHI transfer to vendor environments. Can Redwood provide a standard BAA template?
5) Evidence: redacted report copies via secure link are fine initially; for contract stage we may request full artifact access under NDA.

Attaching: ClearStream_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (proprietary Q), plus a short network diagram (internal).

We can do Tue 9/1 10 AM ET — that works for me. If possible include a representative from your legal/security team to discuss BAA and artifact access.

Alex Carter
Director, Procurement & Security
ClearStream Health
alex.carter@clearstream-health.com

Appreciate the fast answers and the questionnaire, Alex — that helps. A couple of clarifications from our side so we map fields correctly: 

- PHI handling: we can support a pilot with PHI under a signed BAA. I'll loop in our Legal & Security leads once you confirm the contract contact.
- Retention: for pilot scopes we can apply a 90-day retention policy and ensure KV cache TTLs align; for production we can scope retention in the MAP.
- Evidence handling: we support secure link delivery for redacted SOCs and can provide SOC 2 artifacts under strict access controls once an NDA/contract is in place.

Questions for your security team (for the prefill):
• Which SIG Lite sections are you most interested in (Access Control, Encryption, Change Management, Logging)? If you call out priorities we’ll prefill those first.
• For network topology: are you using a VPC peering or SFTP to push data to vendors? We need to map ingress/egress expectations.
• For BAA: please share the contact at procurement/legal to receive our standard BAA draft.

I’ll convert your PDF questionnaire into our SIG mapping and return a prefilled spreadsheet by EOD 2026-09-02 (assuming we have the procurement contact). I’ll also attach a short MAP with milestones: prefill -> review -> BAA execution -> SIG full if needed -> production onboarding.

Proposed attendees for Tue 9/1: Alex Carter, ClearStream security rep (security@clearstream-health.com), Rachel Kim (Customer Success), Emily Park (Redwood Security — TBC), Julia Morales (Redwood Legal — TBC).

If Tue 10 AM ET still works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Soojin
